text:
nora: FYI rolled vector-fallback kernel to canary pool-2 for short seqs. Seeing host ingress CPU climb and grpc microframe tail. Anyone else?

tariq: Confirmed. Quick replay (2k reqs) shows p50 host CPU +10%, p99 grpc smallwrite latency +40%. Flame points to preparse::header_normalize and http2::frame_chunk.

sam: The vector-fallback avoids SIMD utf8 path when mixed ascii/unicode, but it also changes fragment windowing which increases split frames. More splits -> more writev ops.

vela: Perf sample from canary:
```
# perf top
 preparse::header_normalize  21.0%
 net::writev_emit              13.5%
 http2::frame_write           9.2%
 kv_cache::lookup             4.8%
```

perf-bot: replay summary: 2k reqs baseline p50=40ms p99=260ms; post-roll p50=44ms p99=365ms. avg writev/request +19%. KV hit stable.

tariq: Not seeing kvcache miss storms. This looks like framing fragmentation and extra memcpy in normalize.

sam: Two candidate fixes: 1) revert vector-fallback on canary; 2) tweak pool coalesce_window from 32->56 and test. Also consider adding an optional kvcache-prefetch when header keys seen.

nora: Do revert first, collect pprof and writev counts. Then run controlled A/B: vector-fallback vs vector-fallback+prefetch vs baseline.

deploy-bot: pool-2 rollback started by nora at 2026-03-23T21:05:12Z  status: in_progress.

vela: I can add request.metric.writev_count and expose in the temporary replay CSV so we can correlate.

tariq: I ran a microbench toggling normalize: forcing inlined normalize shows +11% host CPU but reduces fragments by ~12% because it coalesces headers earlier. Mixed tradeoffs.

sam: Suggest hybrid chooser: prefer vector-fallback only when fragment_count==0 and header_size<512. That keeps SIMD for messy headers.

nora: Good. After rollback, run the A/B with hybrid and with prefetch on. Also capture strace for write syscalls for a short window.

deploy-bot: rollback completed at 2026-03-23T21:08:01Z  pool-2 back on kernel:v3.1.

perf-bot: kicked off A/B: tags=kernel:vector-fb,kernel:hybrid + prefetch on/off. Will upload CSV to s3 when done.

vela: Dashboard panel added: ingress->host->writev_count per request. link: https://dash.redwood/ingress/writev_count_panel

tariq: If hybrid keeps CPU within 2% of baseline and prefetch cuts writev by ~10%, ship hybrid + gated prefetch. Prefetch behind feature flag to rollback quickly if subtle kvcache churn appears.

sam: I'll draft PR: "chooser: vector-fallback hybrid gating + optional header-prefetch" and include fuzz harness for fragmented http2 bursts.

nora: Thanks. We'll validate 4h canary after merge before prod rollout. Close thread, will monitor perf-bot results.
